structured.reason: The description contains a caveat about performance that the criterion prohibits: "Reapply as needed during hot weather or long activity." This implies the product needs re-application under certain conditions, which mirrors the reviewer complaint that it "may need to reapply" when "really hot." Under the strict standard, any hedge or conditional performance statement fails. The "help skin feel dry and comfortable" phrasing is also softened rather than a pure positive, though the reapply line alone is sufficient to fail.
